snippet.title: Mistpaw Ravine - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3735490/Mistpaw_Ravine/

The witches are gone. Only their cats remain. Make a new home for them in this feline city-builder. Keep your cats fed and happy, clean their litter box, and endure the toxic mist of a world ravaged by magic.

Music by Topher Anselmo -  https://x.com/tophtacular
